newsitem.title: CANADA: Thirsty Canadian thief grabs truckload of beer.
newsitem.headline: Thirsty Canadian thief grabs truckload of beer.

text.p: A thirsty thief hijacked a transport truck loaded with $60,000 Canadian ($43,748 U.S.) worth of beer, police in this town outside Vancouver said on Thursday.
Surrey police said a man armed with a handgun forced the truck's driver to go to a nearby town where he released him and then took off with the beer truck.
The truck was loaded with 5,700 cases of beer. Police said the suspect was still at large.
